name: Amara Okonkwo
bio: Backend engineer. Spends most of her time making Postgres queries stop being slow.

name: Tobias Lindqvist
bio: SRE at a payments company. Runs Kubernetes so other people do not have to. Still not convinced service meshes were worth it.

name: Priya Raghunathan
bio: Android developer, eight years in. Currently migrating a 200k-line codebase off Fragments and regretting every optimistic estimate.

name: Mateusz Wojciechowski
bio: Embedded C on ARM Cortex-M. Interested in why the linker script does what it does. Distrusts anything that allocates.

name: Sofia Marchetti
bio: Frontend, mostly React and CSS. Writes about layout bugs that only appear in Safari.

name: Daniel Osei
bio: Freelance full stack. Ships Rails and Postgres for small businesses. Will argue that most SaaS could be a cron job and a table.

name: Yuki Tanabe
bio: Game developer working in Unity and a bit of custom C++. Spends too long on frame pacing for a game nobody has played yet.

name: Ana Lucia Ferreira
bio: Data engineer. Airflow, dbt, and a long-running argument about whether the warehouse should own business logic.

name: Callum Reid
bio: QA engineer who writes more code than most developers I test for. Flaky tests are a design problem, not a retry setting.

name: Nadia Haddad
bio: Application security. Reads other people's authentication code for a living and rarely enjoys it.

name: Jonas Brandt
bio: Tech lead for a small platform team. Half my week is code, half is convincing people not to add another queue.

name: Grace Whitfield
bio: Retired sysadmin. Ran mail and DNS for a university for twenty-two years. Still keeps a FreeBSD box in the basement out of habit.

name: Kenji Morikawa
bio: Compiler and runtime work, mostly on the JVM. Interested in escape analysis and why it gives up more often than the docs suggest.

name: Isabela Rojas
bio: Second-year CS student. Learning Go by rewriting small Unix tools badly and then reading the real source.

name: Aleksei Vorobyov
bio: Distributed systems, Rust and a lot of Go. Currently annoyed by how hard it is to test partial network failures honestly.

name: Marie Delacroix
bio: Teaches web development at a technical college and writes the course material herself because the textbooks are four frameworks behind.

name: Ravi Shankar Menon
bio: Twenty years of backend Java, now mostly Kotlin. Has migrated the same domain model across three architectures and has opinions about all of them.

name: Elena Petrova
bio: ML engineer working on recommendation ranking. More of my job is data leakage detection than modelling.

name: Marcus Oyelaran
bio: iOS developer. Swift concurrency convert, still finding actor reentrancy bugs from the migration.

name: Linh Nguyen
bio: Platform engineer. Builds internal tooling and CI pipelines. Believes most build slowness is caching that was never configured.

name: Stefan Novak
bio: Works on billing systems. Money in floats is a personal enemy. Knows more about timezone edge cases than he wanted to.

name: Fatima Al Rashid
bio: Cloud architect, mostly AWS. Spends a lot of time explaining that a Lambda is not free just because it is idle.

name: Hugo Almeida
bio: Junior backend developer, one year in. Currently trying to understand database transaction isolation properly instead of guessing.

name: Sarah Kimani
bio: Builds offline-first mobile apps for low-bandwidth regions. Sync conflict resolution is the whole job.

name: Peter Halvorsen
bio: DevOps for an industrial firm. Terraform, on-prem hardware, and systems older than some of my colleagues.

name: Wei Chen
bio: Frontend performance work. Measures things before changing them, which turns out to be a rare position.

name: Camila Vargas
bio: Full stack developer at a logistics startup. TypeScript everywhere, some Python where the maps happen.

name: Owen Baptiste
bio: Database administrator turned consultant. Called in when replication lag becomes a business problem.
